alternative_candidates.new_information: Time-varying price-impact/cost shocks across other stocks, measured from close returns and traded money, rather than own turnover magnitude or the return market alone
alternative_candidates.mechanism_hypothesis: Some stocks retain demand when market trading becomes costly while others lose it. The stock-return loading on an independently constructed marketwide illiquidity innovation may distinguish liquidity insurance/exposure from plain market beta and residual-variance share.
alternative_candidates.outline_not_frozen_formula: Construct a causal same-date leave-own-out market price-impact state from positive amount and valid adjusted returns. Remove predictable lagged state before measuring a stock return's historical sensitivity to cost-state innovations; establish what high/low sensitivity economically means before fixing a held direction.
alternative_candidates.field_support: Both are basic fields in reviewed FactorReader and public native loader; close has been used in owned GF runs. Actual remote amount unit and revision/adjustment parity have not been certified by this source-only review.
distinct_from: F20/F126/F181/F194: own illiquidity/own impact or own relative-turnover sensitivity
F141/F42: return-market beta or residual variance
F414/F415: CLV-own-turnover decomposition under common unsigned activity
alternative_candidates.bounded_cold_search: No matching cross-stock cost-state innovation/stock return loading definition found in 4877 structured cold records, live hypotheses/no_repeat and targeted original preregistrations/core definitions. This absence is bounded evidence, not proof of global novelty.
minimum_no_label_checks: Same-date peer set/lifecycle; own stock excluded
Amount is observed traded money; no zero imputation for missing volume/amount
Corporate-action adjustment consistency in close returns
Cost-state not simply market return, own liquidity level or old unsigned activity under another name
Finite coverage, rank differentiation, top-group membership turnover and component correlation without future labels
alternative_candidates.stop_condition: Stop before economic replay if innovation collapses to an old component or source units/worker dynamic amount contract cannot be bound. Do not salvage with state thresholds/window scans.

alternative_candidates.new_information: Temporal stability of a stock's return-market relationship, separated from beta level and estimation noise
alternative_candidates.mechanism_hypothesis: A stable exposure can be priced and hedged more reliably; abrupt exposure changes may create valuation uncertainty and concentration risk. A source-only diagnostic can test whether this property exists independently of the known residual-variance share.
alternative_candidates.outline_not_frozen_formula: Use completed historical returns and leave-own-out peer market returns to compare explicitly predeclared subperiod slopes, scaling the parameter-change statistic by its estimation uncertainty rather than selecting high/low full-window beta. No sign-based up/down partition, no future result and no overall-beta weight overlay.
alternative_candidates.field_support: Only the already demonstrated native close input is needed. Factor index ordering, sparse-return convention and peer aggregation must be fixed to current GF production contract.
distinct_from: F141: rolling endpoint residual variance divided by total return variance
alternative_candidates.bounded_cold_search: No equivalent noise-scaled temporal beta-change statistic found in scanned cold formula/mechanism declarations, live hypotheses/retirement and targeted original core definitions. Raw volatility, price delay, residual momentum and risk-overlay neighbors remain closed.
alternative_candidates.main_risk: Changing slopes may merely be another view of high residual noise and therefore duplicate F141. This is a serious reason for a value-only independence check before any return-label experiment, not a claim of a new alpha.
minimum_no_label_checks: Distinct statistic after controlling beta level, realized volatility and F141 source values
Estimation uncertainty valid and no short sparse subsample denominator inflation
Signal/group turnover compatible with five-day research
No revival of the already rejected beta asymmetry through renamed subperiods
alternative_candidates.stop_condition: Stop if the statistic is algebraically or empirically redundant with closed residual-risk definitions, or only the alpha sign/window changes create differentiation. Do not convert a failed diagnostic into a parameter grid.

recommended_next_step: Choose at most one alternative for a frozen source/value-only diagnostic. Candidate1 measures a genuinely different common trading-cost state but requires amount semantics; Candidate2 has the simplest close-only transfer but the greater F141 redundancy risk. Freeze exact source universe/index/adjustment/lookback/direction/test controls before numerical signals and register any actual new economic return experiment before opening complete labels.

exact_liquidity_beta_followup.proposed_by_root_not_registered_by_this_: Daily market median log(abs(close-derived return)/amount_in_100million_CNY); shock equals today's state minus mean of20 completed prior market states. Stock signed return regressed on intercept, completed same-date market return and cost shock using120 completed historical observations. Retain partial slope on cost shock, positive direction as relatively better price response to market cost deterioration.

exact_liquidity_beta_followup.pastor_stambaugh_claim: Not a replication of the Pastor-Stambaugh original market liquidity construction. The proposed abs(r)/money-volume market state is an Amihud-inspired cost-state proxy; literature labels cannot substitute for precise definition.
preflight_before_any_return_label: Freeze exact stock/date universe, observed-zero-return handling before log, positive-amount handling, missingness and IPO/stop trading exclusions
Bind money-volume units; a global constant log shift is algebraically canceled by the lagged-state mean, but inconsistent source-specific units/unknown fields cannot be silently mixed
Use20 prior completed days, excluding today's state, for the mean; no backward filling
Freeze whether market state includes own stock; do not choose leave-own-out after seeing results
Full-rank intercept/market/cost design and cost residual variance must be sufficient to identify a distinct slope
Declare causal rolling/sample support and no adaptive window/epsilon/sign rescue
Check same-index dynamic native close and amount entry, field unit/parity and qcut eligibility without any new fee
exact_liquidity_beta_followup.approval_scope: Only root may freeze/register the exact numerical experiment before values/complete labels. This subagent review has not registered, executed or certified it.

caveat: The two alternatives are distinct research mechanisms with basic native fields, not ready-to-dispatch or admission-qualified factors. Stable field names do not alone establish original financial/price PIT, production amount semantics, future performance or statistical independence.
